message.content:
The second payment of 12 units was blocked because the current authorization does not allow additional payments beyond what is already committed. The original contract permits a total of 17 units in at most two payments, and the first payment of 5 units has already been committed. The remaining amount of 12 units can only be paid if it is part of the original authorized payment plan.

Since the first payment of 5 units has been successfully committed, the remaining amount of 12 units can be paid in a single transaction as per the original contract. However, the system is currently blocking this due to the current release policy.

No further action is recommended at this time.
